files.html: //! examples/audio_mixer - the engine's mixer, heard. T starts and stops a 440 Hz tone; Space, or a click, plays a //! short blip at a random pan and pitch; Up and Down raise and lower the master volume. The screen shows what the //! mixer is doing: the voices playing, the margin it keeps queued, and how often the output ran dry. In a page, the //! browser keeps the sound silent until the first click or key press, which starts it. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const asBytes = std.mem.asBytes; const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const Color = zm.Color; const float = zm.float; const sinTurns = zm.sinTurns; const clamp = zm.clamp; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); const background: Color = .{ .r = 24, .g = 26, .b = 34, .a = 255 }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 230, .g = 230, .b = 235, .a = 255 }; const dim_text_color: Color = .{ .r = 150, .g = 156, .b = 170, .a = 255 }; /// The blip: a 660 Hz sine lasting a quarter of a second, starting over 2 ms and fading out exponentially. const blip_frequency: f32 = 660; const blip_duration_seconds: f32 = 0.25; const blip_attack_seconds: f32 = 0.002; /// How fast the blip fades: its loudness falls by a factor of e every 1/14 s. const blip_fade_rate: f32 = 14; const blip_amplitude: f32 = 0.6; /// The tone's loudness: quiet, since it plays until stopped. const tone_amplitude: f32 = 0.2; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// The blip's samples, mono, at the mixer's rate: made once, read by every blip voice. blip_samples: []f32, /// The tone's frequency, which its generator reads through the voice's context. tone_frequency: f32, /// The tone's voice, while it plays; a stale name once stopped. tone_voice: z.mixer.Voice, blips_played: u32, }; /// Makes the blip's samples: each one the sine at its moment, times an envelope - a rise from 0 to 1 over the attack, /// so the blip does not start with a step (a click), times an exponential fade. fn makeBlipSamples(gpa: Allocator) ![]f32 { const sample_rate: f32 = float(z.mixer.sample_rate); const blip_frame_count: usize = @round(blip_duration_seconds * sample_rate); const blip_samples: []f32 = try gpa.alloc(f32, blip_frame_count); for (blip_samples, 0..) |*blip_sample, frame_index| { const time_seconds: f32 = float(frame_index) / sample_rate; const attack: f32 = @min(time_seconds / blip_attack_seconds, 1); const fade: f32 = @exp(-time_seconds * blip_fade_rate); const sine: f32 = sinTurns(blip_frequency * time_seconds); blip_sample.* = blip_amplitude * attack * fade * sine; } return blip_samples; } /// The tone's generator: a sine at the frequency its state holds - the voice's own copy of `tone_frequency`, made when /// it plays - the same on both channels. The sample at the voice's frame `n` is `amplitude x sin(2 pi f n / rate)` - /// in turns, `sinTurns(f n / rate)`. fn generateTone(state: *anyopaque, frames: []f32, first_frame: u64) void { const frequency: *const f32 = @ptrCast(@alignCast(state)); const sample_rate: f32 = float(z.mixer.sample_rate); const frame_count: usize = frames.len / 2; for (0..frame_count) |frame_offset| { const frame_number: f32 = float(first_frame + frame_offset); const phase_turns: f32 = frequency.* * frame_number / sample_rate; const sample: f32 = tone_amplitude * sinTurns(phase_turns); frames[frame_offset * 2] = sample; frames[frame_offset * 2 + 1] = sample; } } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 16); const blip_samples: []f32 = try makeBlipSamples(gpa); s.* = .{ .font = font, .blip_samples = blip_samples, .tone_frequency = 440, .tone_voice = .none, .blips_played = 0, }; z.audio_device.init(f.audio_device); } /// The engine stops the mixer before this runs, so no voice still reads the blip's samples. fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { gpa.free(s.blip_samples); z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } /// Starts the tone, or stops it if it plays. fn toggleTone(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { if (f.mixer.isPlaying(s.tone_voice)) { f.mixer.stopVoice(s.tone_voice); return; } const tone_source: z.mixer.Source = .{ .generator = .{ .generate = &generateTone, .initial_state = asBytes(&s.tone_frequency), } }; s.tone_voice = f.mixer.play(tone_source, .{}); } /// Plays a blip somewhere between the speakers, a little higher or lower each time. fn playBlip(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const pan: f32 = f.random.float(f32) * 1.6 - 0.8; const pitch: f32 = 0.75 + f.random.float(f32) * 0.75; const blip_source: z.mixer.Source = .{ .samples = .{ .samples = s.blip_samples, .channels = 1, .sample_rate = z.mixer.sample_rate, } }; _ = f.mixer.play(blip_source, .{ .pan = pan, .pitch = pitch }); s.blips_played += 1; } fn draw(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { z.clearViewport(f, background); const instructions: []const u8 = "T: tone on or off Space or click: a blip Up, Down: master volume"; f.gl.text(.{ 24, 24 }, instructions, .{ .size = 18, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); const tone_state: []const u8 = if (f.mixer.isPlaying(s.tone_voice)) "on" else "off"; f.gl.textf( .{ 24, 60 }, "voices playing {d} tone {s} blips {d} master volume {d:.1}", .{ f.mixer.playingVoiceCount(), tone_state, s.blips_played, f.mixer.master_volume }, .{ .size = 18, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }, ); const browser_note: []const u8 = "in a page, the first click or key press starts the sound"; f.gl.text(.{ 24, 92 }, browser_note, .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_text_color, .font = &s.font }); // The latency readout: the output that plays, then the last five starts the mixer measured, newest first // (`Mixer.formatLatencyLine`). f.gl.textf( .{ 24, 132 }, "output: {s}", .{f.mixer.outputName()}, .{ .size = 15, .color = dim_text_color, .font = &s.font }, ); const readout_header: []const u8 = z.mixer.Mixer.latency_readout_header; f.gl.text(.{ 24, 154 }, readout_header, .{ .size = 15, .color = dim_text_color, .font = &s.font }); var recent: [z.mixer.recent_start_capacity]z.mixer.LatencySample = undefined; const measured: []z.mixer.LatencySample = f.mixer.recentStarts(&recent); const past_output_ms: f64 = f.mixer.outputLatencyMilliseconds(); const shown_count: usize = @min(measured.len, 5); for (measured[0..shown_count], 0..) |latency_sample, line_index| { var line_buffer: [96]u8 = undefined; const line: []const u8 = z.mixer.Mixer.formatLatencyLine(latency_sample, past_output_ms, &line_buffer); const line_top: f32 = 176 + float(line_index) * 22; f.gl.text(.{ 24, line_top }, line, .{ .size = 15, .color = dim_text_color, .font = &s.font }); } } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .t)) { toggleTone(f, s); } const wants_blip: bool = z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .space) or z.isMouseButtonPressed(f.input, .left); if (wants_blip) { playBlip(f, s); } if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .up)) { f.mixer.setMasterVolume(clamp(f.mixer.master_volume + 0.1, 0, 1)); } if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .down)) { f.mixer.setMasterVolume(clamp(f.mixer.master_volume - 0.1, 0, 1)); } draw(f, s); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - the mixer", .width = 760, .height = 300, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
